label: preparing
what: A surprise tribute celebrating the mayor's forty years of service, in the great hall at 18:00 under cover of Builder's lighting inspection. Secretary reported the purpose privately; Innkeeper arranged bread, Freight delivered it, and Builder arranged the timed inspection. Secretary knowingly coordinates attendance and seeks supply funding; Baker is involved in obtaining additional bread supplies, though knowledge of the surprise itself is uncertain. Neighbour relays the funding request but has promised no assistance. The hall reportedly has 128 fresh loaves and organizers seek 72 more.
